payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sorts voters by cost. For each possible final vote count k for party 1, buy cheapest votes from other parties that have >=k, then buy any cheapest until party 1 has k votes. Take min cost.
payload.rationale: Solution sorts by cost and iterates over vote targets. Greedily buys votes to reduce other parties below target then meets own target using cheapest remaining votes, a direct greedy sorting order pattern.
